attributes.title: 2027 NONPF 53rd Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Organization of Nurse Practitioner Faculties
attributes.summary:
NONPF's 53rd Annual Conference is set for April 14 to 18, 2027, in New Orleans. It is aimed at nurse practitioner educators and covers curriculum and competency-based assessment, AI and simulation in teaching, clinical placements and preceptors, faculty development, student success and DNP education.

The venue, fees and contact hours were not in the material we could read; we will add them once NONPF publishes them.
